$comment: Copy to guardrails.config.json. It is looked for in three places, first match wins: the path in the GUARDRAILS_CONFIG environment variable, then the session's working directory, then hooks/ next to guardrails.mjs. Universal rules — secrets in git, destructive history rewrites — are built in and always apply; this file only adds project-specific friction. Only 'ask' and 'deny' exist: the hook never auto-approves anything.

rules.why: Runs the suite against LIVE model calls (costs real money). The zero-cost path is test:e2e:recorded, which replays saved fixtures. Confirm before spending.
Pushing main triggers the production deploy. Outward-facing — confirm before promoting.
down -v DELETES the local volumes. Irreversible — back it up or run it yourself.
Touches the local database schema or data. Confirm before mutating.
